name: Whisper AI
tagline: Whisper AI is an online speech-to-text and AI transcription workspace that turns spoken audio and video into accurate, editable, searchable text
description: Whisper AI is an online speech-to-text and AI transcription workspace that turns spoken audio and video into accurate, editable, searchable text. It is powered by OpenAI's open Whisper model, which handles accents, background noise, technical terms, and multilingual recordings far better than older dictation tools.
